speaker: interviewer
text: Thanks for coming. What happened in the simulation, in your words?

speaker: candidate
text: I let the team decide. I did not want to push my own idea.

speaker: interviewer
text: You wrote that you prefer to make decisions independently. How does that fit?

speaker: candidate
text: I am not sure. It depends on the situation.

speaker: interviewer
text: You were listed as the leader of a class event. What did you personally do?

speaker: candidate
text: I do not remember exactly. The group did most of it.

speaker: interviewer
text: When the plan in the simulation fell apart, what did you do?

speaker: candidate
text: I think we just kept going.

speaker: interviewer
text: Is there a time you proposed something new?

speaker: candidate
text: Not really. I usually wait to see what others think.

speaker: interviewer
text: Why do you want to study at inVision U?

speaker: candidate
text: Several people recommended it, so I applied.
